description.narrative: COVID-19 outbreak effectively controlled and adverse effects on the poor and vulnerable population and businesses reduced

Poverty and unemployment indicators return to the pre-shock levels of 11.5% and 1.6%, respectively Data Source: World Bank's poverty data/International Labour Organization's employment data Actual value:

Myanmar's preparedness capacity, assessed by the Operational Readiness Index, increased by at least 5 points to 69% or more Data Source: Operational Readiness Index published by World Health Organization Baseline value: 64% compliance
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Health system strengthened for COVID-19 prevention and control Indicator: At least 80% of health personnel at the six designated COVID-19 hospitals (at least 65% of whom are women) trained in COVID-19 management protocols and standard operation procedures, including the special guidelines for the management of COVID-19 during pregnancy Data Source: Progress report from the Ministry of Health and Sports Actual value:

Output: MSMEs safeguarded and workers supported during the economic downturn Indicator: To encourage firms to retain workers, at least 30,000 MSMEs (of which at least 30% are owned by women) received 10% nonrefundable tax credits on the incremental wage bill and 125% tax deduction of the wage bill Data Source: Reports from the Ministry of Planning, Finance and Industry Actual value:

Output: Health system strengthened for COVID-19 prevention and control Indicator: Daily laboratory testing capacity increased to 3,010 Data Source: Progress report from the Ministry of Health and Sports Actual value:

Output: Health system strengthened for COVID-19 prevention and control Indicator: The number of intensive care beds for COVID-19 at (a) the state and regional hospitals (200 bedded and above) and (b) the six designated COVID-19 hospitals increased to a total of 500 Data Source: Progress report from the Ministry of Health and Sports Actual value:

Output: Indicator Indicator: To help cope with COVID-19, 457,000 pregnant women and children under 2 years of age received one-off $21.50 cash transfer Data Source: Progress report from the Ministry of Social Welfare, Relief and Resettlement Actual value:

Output: Indicator Indicator: At least 5.5 million vulnerable households (at least 50% of which are female household members), especially poor people without regular income, received one-off $28.50 cash transfer Data Source: Progress report from the General Administration Department under Ministry of the Office of the Union Government Actual value:

Output: MSMEs safeguarded and workers supported during the economic downturn Indicator: At least 7,000 affected MSMEs, of which 30% are owned by women, received working capital Data Source: Reports from the Ministry of Planning, Finance and Industry Actual value:

Output: Health system strengthened for COVID-19 prevention and control Indicator: At least 9,000 community quarantine centers for COVID-19 operationalized and supported, in compliance with gender-responsive standard operational guidelines Data Source: Progress report from the Ministry of Health and Sports Actual value:

Output: Social assistance provided to the poor and vulnerable groups and populations at risk Indicator: To support input purchases in time for monsoon planting, cash or in-kind support provided to at least 1.55 million smallholder farmer families (with at least 50% female household members) who have lost sales revenue or remittance income Data Source: Progress report from Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock and Irrigation Baseline year: 2020 Baseline value: no support Baseline year: 2020 Baseline value: no support Target year: 2020 Target value: support provided
